question: A negatively charged rod is brought near an isolated neutral metal sphere placed on an insulating stand and then removed without touching or earthing the sphere. Predict the final charge on the sphere. Give reason.

options.A: The sphere becomes negatively charged because electrons are pushed to the far side
options.B: The sphere remains neutral because only temporary charge separation occurs
options.C: The sphere becomes positively charged because electrons leave the sphere
options.D: The sphere gets permanently charged because the rod is brought near it
